description: Metadata JSON document for adding information to orders.
title: AppData Root Schema

appCode.description: The code identifying the CLI, UI, service generating the order.
appCode.title: App Code

environment.description: Environment from which the order came from.
environment.title: Environment

metadata.description: Each metadata will specify one aspect of the order.
metadata.title: Metadata

enableFastPath.description: Opt into out-of-competition ("fast path") execution. When set, the order can be settled directly by the winning quote's solver, within a short exclusivity window, instead of waiting for the next batch auction.
enableFastPath.title: Enable Fast Path

validFrom.description: Earliest time, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds, at which the order may enter a batch auction. Honored if set; for fast-path orders the backend picks a value when this is not provided.
validFrom.title: Valid From
